name: io.github.oreiasccp/yt-transcript-mcp
title: YouTube Transcript + Search (local)
description: Local, self-hosted MCP for YouTube transcripts (native captions first, faster-whisper fallback), local audio/video transcription, and YouTube search. Runs from your own residential IP.

environmentVariables.name: YT_COOKIES_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Browser yt-dlp reads cookies from on the escalation retry (chrome, firefox, edge, brave…; empty to disable).

environmentVariables.name: YT_WHISPER_DEVICE
environmentVariables.description: faster-whisper device: 'cuda' (default, GPU-first) or 'cpu'. Falls back to CPU automatically when no GPU is present.

environmentVariables.name: YT_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Restrict transcribe_local_file to these directories (OS-path-separator list). Unset = unrestricted.
